findings.title: Missed departure observation leaves short-play note available to label a later independent play
reproduction: Real HubCore onboarded 200 tracks of 180 s; app observes initial song, then arrival of T after a skip at progress 1 s, recording fresh lane note.
T is skipped after 6 s total so FakeSpotify does not list T. Another song plays 60 s without app player look. Cached snapshot remains T.
Controlled replacement deck fixture changes T reason to favorite and writtenAt, preserving track/order. Invoke actual HubCore.saveDeck so closeLaneNotes executes; restart HubCore over same sqlite.
Spotify plays T again in same playlist for 45 s entirely between app looks; skip, force real HubCore sync. Spotify listing creates one counted T history row.
findings.expected: The later occurrence has no proven link to the short earlier arrival. Return null for its lane rather than asserting fresh or inferring favorite from current deck. Retain observed paused long-occurrence lane where a matching occurrence is established.
findings.cause: closeLaneNotes compares only track id to cached player and exempts T even when snapshot is stale. Next closing look sets goneAt to now, so the listing ending before now passes the stamp bound and consumes old note. Missing intermediate look defeats occurrence binding.
findings.impact: False reason-of-play label in persisted History; no demonstrated changed queue/count/transport effect.
findings.repair_direction: Fence lane note consumption to the actual observed occurrence and provenance; ambiguous unobserved departures/repeats must yield null. Do not use wall time alone to fabricate completion or close genuine paused occurrence.
required_checks: Original paused same-occurrence across long pause/replacement
Listing dedup/count, read-only history, native/private/guest and stable queue regressions
findings.limits: Controlled deck publication fixture invokes real persistence/closure logic; no claim this exact replacement was reproduced through public rebuild workflow or live Spotify. FakeSpotify is simulation, not live latency/quota evidence.

findings.title: Coalesced genre request bypasses the callers session epoch validation
findings.preconditions: A valid current listener session has an active genre estimate; another still correctly signed/unexpired cookie for the same account has a revoked epoch. No cross-account forgery is involved.
reproduction: Create actual UserHub around onboarded HubCore with imported profile and hold optional AI promise.
Call estimateGenres(currentEpoch-1) before provider resolves: it returns same promise without running session(epoch).
Release usable provider response: stale RPC returns ok:true and private genre result.
Repeat through actual Worker.fetch POST/api/profile/genres, x-ts:1 and correctly signed test cookie whose epoch is currentEpoch-1: HTTP200 with current profile estimate/summary instead of401.
findings.expected: Every caller validates its own session epoch even when joining an active flight, and revoked-session requests cannot read current private result. Keep optional provider await outside playback lock.
findings.actual: RPC ok:true; HTTP200 JSON contains current estimate {source:workers-ai,genres:[{name:Pop,share:100}],summary:Sensitive taste}.
findings.cause: genreFlight is checked/returned before session(epoch); only first caller supplies epoch used for prepare/store gates.
findings.impact: Account logout/revocation contract is bypassed for a previously revoked session while another current session has an active genre estimate. This is a material auth/privacy regression, not an unauthenticated route or cross-account-ID bypass.
findings.repair_direction: Validate each caller independently before joining scoped flight, retain coalescing and result/store fencing, and ensure old epoch cannot reuse a new epoch flight.
required_tests: Current and revoked signed cookie concurrent POSTs must produce200/401 respectively.
Valid concurrent requests still share exactly1provider call.
Pause remains unblocked during provider await.
Logout/new epoch and delayed provider result tests retain authorization/store fencing.
